title: ChemInform Abstract: Synthesis and Structure of Au<sub>6</sub>(CH<sub>3</sub>C<sub>6</sub>H<sub>4</sub>CS<sub>2</sub>)<sub>6</sub>, a Novel Gold Cluster Compound.
abstract: AbstractThe new gold title compound (I) is prepared by addition of NaAuCl4‐2 H2O to the Pr4N+ salt of the ligand, each dissolved in DMF, in a 2:1 ligand to metal molar ratio (no yield given).
